name: Half Glow
description: Light one half of a thing and read the shape of the half left dark.

name: Phase Mark
description: Mark a foe at one phase and tug its stance to the opposite phase.

name: Silver Hop
description: Skim from one lit patch to its twin in a light bound.

name: Twin Phase Pull
description: Pull a foe in two phases at once so it cannot settle on a stance.

name: Phase Screen
description: Raise a screen with a bright face and a dark one that turns a blow aside.

name: Matched Wake
description: Wake two allies together so the strength of one rises with the other.

name: Phase Eclipse
description: Cross one phase over another above a foe so it loses sight and weight.

name: Mated Surge
description: Send a surge from the bright half and another from the dark half to meet on foes.

name: Phase Orbit
description: Set a strong foe orbiting between two phases that give no purchase to escape.

name: Twin Moonfall
description: The school's closing move that drops two moons of pull on the field and crushes foes between them.

name: Hawk Sight
description: Pick a single foe out of a crowd with a gleam as sharp as a hawk's gaze.

name: Perch Tug
description: Tug a foe's weapon from a high perch with a pull cast downward.

name: Bowl Halo
description: Hold a halo in the shape of a basin to catch and slow blows.

name: Hawk Pull
description: Stoop a heavy pull onto a foe's shoulders and push it toward the ground.

name: Brim Surge
description: Let the basin brim over in a short surge that knocks foes off their feet.

name: Bowl Reflection
description: Still the basin to a mirror face and return a blow from its surface.

name: Ebb Sense
description: Feel the ebb of the basin to learn how much pull remains in the field.

name: Held Pull
description: Pin a foe at the bottom of a held basin of pull so it cannot climb out.

name: Wing Tide
description: Spread a tide with wide wings that sweeps foes from both flanks.

name: Hawk Orbit
description: Take a lone strong foe from above and set it circling in a pull it cannot break.

name: Tide Stoop
description: The school's closing stoop that drops the whole basin of pull on a foe from a height.

name: Core Gleam
description: Draw a gleam from the formed core to show what moves beyond the wall of night.

name: Core Tug
description: Tug a foe's stance with a thread of pull taken from the core.

name: Core Halo
description: Hold a halo of core qi round the user that thins every blow.

name: Core Tide
description: Raise a tide from the core that settles on a foe's limbs without strain.

name: Core Wake
description: Wake the dormant core of an ally with a slow pulse of lunar qi.

name: Sky Reflection
description: Hang a sheet of sky-bright reflection that returns a blow to its sender.

name: Core Surge
description: Send a surge from the core across a wide field in one beat.

name: Horizon Pull
description: Pull a foe from the limit of sight and pin it where it stands.

name: Inner Eclipse
description: Eclipse a gathering of foes from the core and weigh each of them down.

name: Sky Orbit
description: The school's closing move that sets every foe in reach circling the user in a core-born pull.

name: Wind Glow
description: Send a glow down the wind and read what it touches.

name: Gust Tug
description: Tug a foe's lead hand on a gust of pull.

name: Pledge Shove
description: Shove a foe with a push held to the user's word.

name: Sworn Tide
description: Lay a tide sworn to stay on a foe until it yields.

name: Bearing Lend
description: Lend an ally a steady bearing drawn from the user's own.

name: Wind Reflection
description: Turn a blow on the wind and return it to the one who threw it.

name: Gust Surge
description: Ride a gust into a surge that shoves every foe in its path.

name: Held Eclipse
description: Hold an eclipse over a foe that dims its sight for as long as the user stands.

name: Wind-Sworn Orbit
description: Swear a strong foe to an orbit on the wind from which it cannot break away.

name: Tide Oath
description: The school's closing oath that sets a sworn tide over every foe in sight.

name: Bare Gleam
description: Cast an honest gleam in the open and read what stands in it.

name: Bare Tug
description: Tug a foe's stance with a pull that needs no cover.

name: Frank Halo
description: Hold a halo in plain sight that turns a blow without a feint.

name: Open Tide
description: Spread a tide across open ground and hold every foe on it back.

name: Open Wake
description: Wake the strength of allies where all can see it done.

name: Stark Reflection
description: Return a blow with a bare bright face that hides nothing.

name: Phase Slip
description: Move one phase aside in plain sight and let a blow pass behind.

name: Bare Surge
description: Send a surge across open ground that has no corner for foes to hide in.

name: Unsheltered Eclipse
description: Draw an eclipse over foes standing in the open and leave them nowhere to see.

name: Open Orbit
description: Set a strong foe circling in plain sight under a pull that needs no cover.

name: Open Moon
description: The school's closing move that opens the full moon over the field and weighs on every foe in it.

name: Oathcore Gleam
description: Raise a gleam from the oath in the core and see who keeps faith.

name: Oathcore Tug
description: Tug a foe's blow aside with a pull drawn from the sworn core.

name: Oathcore Halo
description: Wear a halo of sworn core qi that holds while the oath holds.

name: Distant Tide
description: Run a tide a long way down the wind to settle on a far foe.

name: Oathcore Wake
description: Wake an ally to the oath the ally has sworn so strength comes with it.

name: Oathcore Mirror
description: Return a blow by a mirror of sworn core light.

name: Long Surge
description: Send a surge a very long way across the wind to shove all it meets.

name: Oathcore Eclipse
description: Eclipse a foe's sight with the oath that rests in the core.

name: Oathcore Orbit
description: Hold a powerful foe in an orbit sworn to the user's core.

name: Unending Tide
description: The school's closing move that raises a tide with no ebb and keeps all foes under its pull.
